resolution: Extended the road-render gate to arbitrary cells across multiple chunks (renders all painted chunks; groups cells per chunk for the /quad control and into tight z-clusters for /mesh so adjacent flips resolve; accepts =pass/=fail tags to cross-check against the user's eyes). Fixed a real determinism bug: frame 90 captured before the async heightfield-mesh bake settled (two shots differed 0.86%), so bumped capture to frame 200 (now 0.01% noise). Validated on EK52..EK173 across chunks (1,0)/(1,1): all 6 verdicts match the user's observed state. Characterized the bug reliably from the real /mesh render: a hard, KIND-INDEPENDENT, per-chunk-local cliff at cy~53 — road-family cells (median/crosswalk/junction) render correctly for cy<53 and uniformly as concrete material for cy>=53. Ruled out: tile data, the shared formula (/quad draws asphalt everywhere), D-buffer upload (full 14480 floats, no truncation), mesh extent/resolution (121 verts over 120m, correct), and vertex-buffer truncation (89k<98k cap). Mechanism not yet pinned: a /diag probe route was added but its DiagLandform replica diverges from the real mesh's uv, so it gave contradictory readings and cannot be trusted. Next: instrument the real HEIGHTFIELD_TILE_BODY directly. Committed cf550a5dc, fdd8c791f, 17fa983b9.
